changes.oldSpan: successMessage: "ISA, NISA and IKE are all tax-advantaged wrappers — they let qualifying investments grow without the usual tax drag. +30 tokens!"
changes.newSpan: successMessage: "ISA (UK), NISA (Japan) and IKE (Poland) offer tax advantages under different national rules and limits. For Polish IKE, exemption depends on statutory withdrawal conditions; an earlier return can make investment income taxable. Eligibility, permitted assets and withdrawal rules differ. This comparison does not imply that every account is available to a Polish resident."
